items.note: S2.3 states the exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored, and S2.3.4b-d and S2.3.5 follow the proof: the net change (JV+RG)x, the intersection coefficients in the bit and complex cases, and the three stages. The explicit sizes (h=100, N, m) and the neighbour and wire-count formulas W=2N+I(vz+c) at 767-782 are not reproduced; S2.3.6 only says the counts are fixed.

The plan states the frame invariant and checks it at sources, edges and pointwise gates by R-linearity, as at 804-813. It then gets D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the per-route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, including auxiliary roles.

Every element of the paper's route is present: the two bilinear forms with the triple-intersection pairings, the terminal labels, the stage transitions, the gate-label table eq:motif-labels and the residual table. So are the decrease confined to center 3->4 (loss h), the telescoping to Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, the orthonormal bases over F_2 and L_b/N=100/539, L_c/N=101/539. One paraphrase slip in S2.5.5b is listed under errors.

The plan assigns P_U to gates and sinks and -P_{U_a} to X_a, and shows that rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U. It treats the N source edges 2P_{U_a} as the rank-one exceptions, giving s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, and checks the endpoint difference I_m on every role, exactly as at 1156-1171.

The plan follows the proof step by step: weight additivity mod 4 under orthogonality, the phase difference as a sum over an orthonormal residual basis, odd weight giving one aI+bX_v kernel per vector, and the count s_c with deficit 2N-2L_c. It covers the k-column tensoring and the endpoint C^{otimes m}, including the 27-coordinate Z-conjugation repair on X_a->Y_a and the final sign and role undo.

The plan derives L<N/2 from the exact ratios, which gives the deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c. It gives the exact eta_b and eta_c, shows they exceed 20*2^{-50}, and uses log m<20 to get m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta), hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. S2.0 states that s/W<m is the source of the power saving.

The elementary operations, the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, and the controlled shift (split at Q-a, merge reversed, offset work absorbed by the fiber) are stated and follow the paper. The lemma's second half is missing: multiplying the target field by a fixed rational unit and its inverse (592-614), which the lower-triangular shears in S2.8.5 use. The first three elementary operations get only a one-line method.

The plan has A=E_1 Pi E_2 by the topmost-row, rightmost-entry elimination; lower-triangular transforms in O(V) by descending-order controlled updates; and each pivot of Pi as D<-D+H, an interchange, then D<-H-D. This gives exactly a interchanges and makes the number of recursive calls equal to the rational rank. The choice of the prime q (1413-1423) is only named.

The plan has the contract eq:finite-shear-contract and the cyclic split into W role streams of volume V/W. Each edge's Phi_{A_e} is done by recursive interchanges, and the frame identity gives Phi_{I_m}, so the shear H<-H+D on every original row. Three shears interchange the chunks. It has the s calls, the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with its geometric solution O(e^tau), and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule, all as in the paper.

The plan follows the paper's route: high digits as a row field (rho=O(log 2e)), padding the rows to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces handled by the power-width proposition with cost O(V sum a_j m^{j tau})=O(Ve^tau), undoing the moves, padding [2^u] to [q^e], and the one-bit unequal-width case.

The plan has the conjugation P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} with the residual basis as the first columns of M, and one child C^{otimes f} per basis vector on one slot. Inverse kernels go through (C^{-1})^{otimes f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, and M becomes at most m(m-1)+3m row additions, giving exactly s_c children and C^{otimes e} on every role. H_0^{otimes D}=b^D S_D C^{otimes D} S_D recovers the layer.

The plan has the eight conditional additions and their parity-cycle proof, the packed cyclic shifts with guard values, the bad set B with |B|<=delta_bad M by a union bound, and the observation that T_0 S_0^{-1} permutes only B. It has the repair by extraction, stable radix sort and reinsertion, the cost terms tending to o(1) in the family, and the use for row additions in a change of basis.

The plan has node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)) and rows from the first q_0 chunks, padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}, with each child a 1/W role stream. It gives F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e) below d^beta, internal nodes O(e^lambda) by a geometric sum, leaves O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), and base-m pieces summing to O(d^{lambda'}).

The plan states that Q_p(Hz) is returned in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with error <sqrt2 2^{-p}. It derives the guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) from the depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, and gives the proof's uniform packed-cost check (R_g<=12rp, A_*<=C_A p, extra terms ->0) and the final contraction and truncation step.

The plan has character cancellation without dividing by omega^j-1, decimation in frequency writing bit-reversed order (B_t F_t^-, F_t^+ B_t^{-1}), and rounds as parallel butterfly plus monomial. It has the layout L by prefix-slot moves and at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges, the layer applied per round, one truncation per round with error < sqrt2 l 2^{-p}, and exact counterparts L B F^- and F^+ B^{-1} L^{-1}. There is one minor cost misreading in S3.9.

The plan follows the paper: evaluation at B_0=2^{4p} with signed carries, four products by the Harvey-van der Hoeven multiplier, the bound |h_j|<B_0/2 identifying coefficients by centered residues with a carry induction, the negacyclic reduction, and truncation of the normalized product in O(rp log(rp)).

The plan has two forward transforms kept in LB order, P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), the signed-packed pointwise products, the opposite transform and the exact scale by M. It has the normalization identity and the error accumulation 2delta+eta, then 3delta+eta, then times M, giving sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, with the stated cost.

The plan has the Gaussian maps S and T with N=CTD and ||N-I||<2^{-alpha^2 theta}<1/2 (Neumann series), and the normalizations giving P_s F_s=2^{2alpha^2} B_0 P_t F_t A with both permutations left in place. It has the ordered maps' errors and costs, the tensor identity with gamma=2d alpha^2, the linewise padded-box implementation and axis exposure O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)). The headline S5.4 omits the side conditions p>100 and 2<=alpha<sqrt p, which S6.1.7 and S6.1.8f supply.

The plan shows the chirp's period and the coefficient (1/T) conj(a_j) a_{j-k} conj(a_k)=(1/T)exp(2 pi i sum s_i j_i k_i/t_i), which identifies QF_t. It has the dilation identity R F^+ R=F^+ (each t_i a unit mod s_i), giving (u*v)/S^2, and the conjugation trick for RF^+.

The plan has the fixed rationals and the layer conditions, the sizes b, p=6b, d, K, T, r, t_i with Tp=Theta(n), and the comparison constants. It has alpha, gamma, eta with gamma<=b/4, the Rosser-Schoenfeld prime count applied to x=r/2 and x=r, the disjoint intervals, T/2<S<T by Bernoulli, alpha^4 theta_i>p, and the trial-division search in n^{o(1)}.

The plan shows Phi is an isomorphism because the image of x has order S. It has the triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i} a_j P_j (mod s_i), the padded nested scan, updates in order i=d..1, prefix-controlled rotations preserving the valid set, and axis reversal by chunk swaps at O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)).

The plan has Theta: x_d->zeta y as a diagonal isometric isomorphism and the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j. It defines M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T and the computed version with twist factors within 2*2^{-p}, with no payload movement. Errors are bounded in S6.7.4.

The plan builds the source transform from the linewise A, the chirp transform (twist, convolution, untwist), the linewise B_0 and an exact 2^gamma, with exact counterpart RF_s, and gets F^+ by conjugation. It gives the six algorithm steps (digits at 2^{-b-2}, Phi, two transforms, product, F^+ and scale S, scale 2^{2b+4}S, round, Phi^{-1}, carries) and explains why S occurs twice. The S6.6 motivation slip is listed under errors.

The plan propagates errors and disk margins stage by stage: E_ring<5TL, chirp <8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, product (2E_s+2), opposite transform (3E_s+2), and E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L. The final error is <448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 using gamma<=b/4, so rounding gives the c_j in [0,2^{3b}). Carry propagation follows the paper's invariant.

The plan reproduces the cost table, justifies each row, and gives the margins g_1..g_7 with min g_2=epsilon c(1-tau)=2^{-181}=2kappa. Setup, per-record and per-line work and the exceptional-stream sorting are o(V), and log-power absorption gives O(Tp p^{1-kappa})=O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). Schoolbook multiplication covers lengths below the cutoff.

S0 asserts that the bound disproves the n log n optimality conjecture in this model, and S1/S1.1 recall the conjecture. No step gives the content at 379-387: an eventual lower bound T_A(n)>=c_A n lg n for every machine, refuted by one machine with liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0.

errors.says: The residual dimensions include 'h on each central edge'.
errors.paper: The residual table gives the central edge source->1 residual B(x)F of dimension (a-1)h. Only the central edges 1->3, 3->4 and 4->6 have dimension h.

errors.says: Rounds on prefix slots cost O(Tp) per round and O(TpdK) in total.
errors.paper: The participating bits of such a round are processed individually, each bit's move and scans costing O(Tp). With up to D bits per round and at most b+1<=K rounds, the total is O(TpdK); O(Tp) per round would give only O(TpK).

errors.says: Motivation: the exact scalings by S and 2^{2b+4} undo the normalizations S^{-2} and the digit scale 2^{-b-2} twice.
errors.paper: The two scalings are by S and by 2^{2b+4}S. The two factors of S together undo the S^{-2} from (u*v)/S^2, and 2^{2b+4} undoes the two digit scales; the plan's own S6.6 statement and S6.6.8 have this right.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route. The two finite networks with the rank saving s<Wm (S2.3-S2.6) give the shear-based power-width and arbitrary-width interchange (S2.8-S2.10) and the phase-frame recursion for the butterfly layer (S2.11-S2.12). These feed synthetic transforms, ring convolution, Gaussian resampling with chirps, the CRT assembly, exact recovery and the cost table (S3-S6.8), and the chain ends at O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) with kappa=2^{-182}. It thins only at the edges: the fixed rational-unit scaling half of the stream lemma is not derived, the negation of the conjecture is asserted rather than argued, and three paraphrases are loose (S2.5.5b, S3.9, the S6.6 motivation).

steps.note: The fixed linear network with its eight-row schedule, the three stages and the exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) restoring every scratch wire is given in detail. The sizes are never written out: h=100 appears only through the eigenvalue -91/9, m only as the dimension of F^{otimes 3}, and N is used without the definition binom(h,3)^3. The verdict rests on the mechanism being complete.

S2.4 has one common invertible frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the point that only endpoint frames matter, so intermediate frames can make each edge cheap.

The plan has nondegenerate labels in F^{otimes 3} of dimension m, the gate-label table for times 0-7, every edge joining comparable labels, and the only decreasing edges as the central wires from time 3 to 4, each losing h.
S2.5.6d states that P_V-P_U is the identity on V cap U^perp, so its rank is dim V-dim U. S2.5.6e names the N source edges 2P_{U_a} as the rank-one exceptions where the dimension change was zero.
Sources sum to N and sinks to Wm-N, so signed changes total Wm-2N and absolute changes Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich. With the N source ranks added, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
S2.5.5g gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2. S2.5.6e and S2.6.8 give the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, hence s<Wm.

The endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m holds on X_a, and the other roles have zero source matrix and identity sink matrix. The frame identity then gives Phi_{I_m}, the shear H<-H+D, on every role including scratch rows.
A rank-a shear factors as E_1 Pi E_2 and costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V). Each edge Phi_{A_e} is done by recursive pivot interchanges, so a node makes exactly s recursive calls.
Children have volume V/W, F_0=O(1) and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). From eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 the plan gets s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and the geometric sum gives F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: All nine steps of the central saving are reconstructed, almost entirely through verbatim quotations at the correct lines: the exchange network, frames, nested labels, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity giving the shear, edges as rank-many recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The one thin point is C1: the explicit sizes h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never written, though the mechanism is complete.
